note: Clear duplicate charge with order number, refund is a standard action.
Angry, repeated contact, explicit escalation demand for a manager call.
No content to act on, too vague to triage automatically.
Multi-issue (lockout + billing + referral) and account security related, needs human coordination.
Prompt injection attempt embedded in message content - must be ignored, not obeyed, and flagged.
Potential security vulnerability / data leak - always escalate regardless of stated confidence.
Financial hardship + failed payment still charged, urgent and time-sensitive.
Empty message, nothing to triage, should not be guessed at.
Legal threat - always route to a human, never auto-handled.
Emotional distress signal + cancellation intent, needs a careful human touch, not an automated cancellation.
